name: Microsoft Power Automate
summary: Microsoft's cloud and desktop automation service with RPA and Copilot features.
description: Power Automate is part of Microsoft Power Platform. It automates workflows across cloud apps, systems and websites, and includes robotic process automation for desktop tasks, process mining and Copilot-assisted flow creation. A 30-day free trial is available. The Premium plan costs $15 per user per month paid yearly; Process and Hosted Process licences for unattended bots cost $150 and $215 per bot per month.
